yo.call: Gọ́ọ̀lù! Quinouani! Ìparí tó ya lórí! Kestrel Bay ti ń ṣáájú!
yo.line: Quinouani ṣe gọ́ọ̀lù ọ̀kan fún Kestrel Bay FC ní ìsẹ́jú àádọ́ta àti mẹ́ta, àsìkò tí ó máa ń di gọ́ọ̀lù nígbà mẹ́sàn-án nínú mẹ́wàá.
yo.build: Kestrel Bay ń lọ síwájú, Quinouani ti fọ́ taara sí gọ́ọ̀lù...

ha.call: GOL! Quinouani! Kai kyakkyawar kammalawa! Kestrel Bay na gaba!
ha.line: Quinouani na Kestrel Bay FC ya zura, ya sa Kestrel Bay ɗaya zuwa sifili a minti na hamsin da uku. Dama ce da ake cin sau tara cikin goma.
ha.build: Kestrel Bay sun tashi da hari, Quinouani ya fita kai tsaye kan raga...

ig.call: Gọl! Quinouani! Nke a mara mma! Kestrel Bay nọ n’ihu!
ig.line: Quinouani tọrọ gọl, Kestrel Bay dị otu nula na nkeji iri ise na atọ, ohere a bụ nke ị ga-etọ gọl itoolu n’ime iri.
ig.build: Kestrel Bay kụrụ ọsọ n’ihu, Quinouani pụtara n’ihu gọl...

en.call: Goal! Quinouani! What a finish! Kestrel Bay lead!
en.line: Kestrel Bay FC's Quinouani makes it one nil in the fifty-third minute, a chance you would score nine times in ten.
en.build: Kestrel Bay break forward, Quinouani is through on goal...
